Scientific name: Pogonopoma wertheimeri (Steindachner, 1867).

Type locality: Rio Mucuri District, Santa Clara, Bahia State, Brazil.

Maximum size: 223 mm SL.

South America: Mucuri and São Mateus River basins. Currently known from three coastal river drainages in southeastern Brazil: the Mucuri River in Bahia State and the São Mateus River in Espirito Santo State.
Usually found in stretches of river with mid to strong water current and rocky or sandy bottom, although some specimens were collected from a lentic habitat.
Etymology: (Greek) Pogon = beard + (Greek) op = eye + (Greek) poma = lid, operculum. Pronunciation: pog ON oh poma.
Anzeiger der Kaiserlichen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Wien, Mathematisch-Naturwissenschaftliche Classe v. 4 (no. 14) (for 16 May 1867), pp 119.
